thread:
Maya: quick check-in — following the postmortem, we need to finalize owners/timelines for the regional failover gaps. backups looked fine but restore runbook had ambiguous steps. can we lock this down by EOW?
Elaine: copying notes from the postmortem. proposed split: routing rules audit (Devin), restore runbook rewrite + verification (Samir), nightly snapshot retention policy (Tobi). ETA proposals below. :spiral_calendar:
Devin: I can take routing rules audit. will validate multi-region routing policy, session affinity edgecases, and failover TTL. aiming for draft by Thu (1778580000).
Samir: will own the runbook rewrite and run through a restore dry-run. need a checklist for data-restore vs config-restore. planning a dry-run game day next week.
Tobi: will update snapshot retention and add verification alerts. also propose we add a daily restore verification job (lightweight).
Elaine: action items (short):
- Devin: routing rules audit + remediation plan (ETA Thu)
- Samir: restore runbook rewrite + dry-run (ETA Fri, game-day scheduled)
- Tobi: snapshot retention + verification job (ETA Wed)
- Maya: coordinate game day, stakeholder invite, and post-game checklist (ETA Mon)
Ops-bot: scheduled game-day: 2026-05-12 09:00 UTC — created incident-playbook: https://redwood.example/game-days/rd-failover-2026-05-12
Maya: Samir — for the dry-run, can you include an automated KV-cache invalidation step? last time stale KV caused routing to pick old leader.
Samir: good catch. will add explicit KV invalidation and a pre-check script. snippet for pre-check:```bash
# verify latest snapshot exists
gsutil ls gs://redwood-backups/region-*/snapshots | tail -n 5
```
Devin: for routing audit, I'll run a traffic-simulation using the canary harness and send logs to the tracing dashboard. expecting to catch session-affinity leaks.
Maya: timeline constraint: leadership wants mitigation in prod within 2 weeks if obvious fixes exist. anything that needs more time should have a temporary mitigation (routing fallback to single-region with scaled capacity).
Tobi: noted. temp mitigation = enable emergency single-region fallback + scale-up SLO. I'll draft the toggle play and runbook steps.
Elaine: one more recurring pattern from the postmortem: during partial-region loss, autoscaler behaved inconsistently. add to routing audit + SRE to look at scale-on-fail behavior.
Devin: can add SRE to the audit. pinging @Tobi and @Samir for joint test plan.
Maya: next steps: owners confirm on this thread, post ETA in the tracker, and I'll send calendar invites for the game day. please react with :thumbsup: if you accept the owner tasks.
Samir: accepted :thumbsup:
Devin: accepted :thumbsup:
Tobi: accepted :thumbsup:
Elaine: accepted :thumbsup:
Maya: thanks — I'll follow up with the invite and the readout template. adding notes to the action tracker: https://redwood.example/incidents/dr-action-tracker (will link owners/ETAs).
Ops-bot: reminder set: follow-up check-in in 72h (1778750000).
